title: What Happens If You Rest Your Hand on the Gear Shifter
hook: Stop resting your hand on the shifter.

script.narration: Stop resting your hand on the shifter.
script.visual_search: driver hand resting on manual gear shift close up

script.narration: Your car's gear selector fork presses constantly against rotating internal collars. That tiny weight causes premature friction, wearing down brass synchronizer rings inside the transmission.
script.visual_search: car manual transmission gears mechanics workshop

script.narration: Keep both hands on the wheel. Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Do you rest your hand there? Comment yes or no. Because...

description: Stop resting your hand on the gear shifter while driving. This common habit causes premature internal transmission wear and costly repairs over time. Learn how to protect your car's manual or automatic gearbox with simple daily driving habits.
